infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ClassActionForMe uses the camera so you can photograph products on a shelf or in a room. The photo is sent once to detect brand names and is never stored.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ClassActionForMe lets you pick an existing photo of products or a receipt. The photo is sent once to detect brand names and is never stored.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: ClassActionForMe adds claim deadlines to your calendar only when you tap "Add deadline to calendar".
infoPlist.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: ClassActionForMe adds claim deadlines to your calendar only when you tap "Add deadline to calendar".
